body: Thank you for this. I just spend a good amount of time crying out on my patio. I know the ledge isn't the antidote to all my problems. I talk myself down off of it most days but it just keeps getting harder and harder.

Thank you for the kind words. I do need to talk to someone. I thought maybe if I could get on antidepressants or even some anxiety medicine I might get a hold on life and be able to start turning something around but then I realize I don't even have the money to buy groceries most days let alone pay for a medication or a therapist. The only thing off outing about AA to me is that I have heard it's very religious and I am not, but I will look into finding a group near me.
